g.text: 31a · Atomic vector staging commit and production activation
Batch upsert semantic embeddings to staging collection
Notify indexing pipeline completed with vector IDs
Atomically update Reel index status to ACTIVE & store vector IDs
Reel index status committed to database
Invalidate stale semantic search & recommendation cache entries
Confirm Reel is now fully discoverable in production
Two-phase staging ensures search queries never encounter partially indexed Reel vectors
